newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya shilling continues rally against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Kenya shilling continues rally against dollar.

text.p: The Kenyan shilling continued its rally on the dollar posting new highs on Thursday, as large inflows of dollars streamed into the market, dealers said.
The Central Bank of Kenya posted a mean shilling average of 55.49 against the dollar from 55.60 on Wednesday while on the pound, the shilling was unchanged at 93.28.
Dealers said the shilling opened at 55.45/50 from Wednesday's 55.58/62 opening levels.
They said the shilling continued to appreciate as dollar inflows came in from the agricultural sector, horticulture and overseas investors looking to trade in treasury bills.
"We expect dollars to keep coming in from horticulture especially now that the flower season has began in Europe," a commercial dealer said.
One dealer said that the current interest rates on treasury bills were still attractive especially against other currencies, which is why there was the unusual interest from foreigners.
Dealers expected the shilling to maintain its firm tone in the absence of new factors.
The local money market was fairly liquid with a good number of banks lending. Overnight were quoted at between 15-21 percent levels from Wednesday's 20 percent levels.
